scripts.check:wasm: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f=['shell_cblas.js','shell_cblas.wasm','shell_cblas.worker.js'];const m=f.filter(x=>!fs.existsSync('blas_wasm/'+x));if(m.length){console.error('Missing WASM artifacts in blas_wasm/: '+m.join(', ')+'. Run: bash blas_wasm/build.sh');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build:archive: find dist -name .DS_Store -delete; tar --no-mac-metadata --no-xattrs -cf - dist | zstd -19 -f -o dist.tar.zst
scripts.build: npm run check:wasm && npm run build:vite && npm run build:archive
